item.description:
• New full-stage keys: press a chosen key (Enter by default) to light up the whole stage
  • Pick Wave, Sweep or Flash for each key, with animated previews under More in the console
  • Full-stage keys play only the full-stage effect, and work in recordings and replays
  • Esc and other function keys can be full-stage keys too

• 新增全场键：按下指定的键（默认 Enter），整条演出区一起演出
  • 每个全场键可单独选择冲击波、横扫或齐放，控制台「更多」里用动态卡片挑选
  • 全场键只演整场演出，不叠加单键效果；录制与回放同样生效
  • Esc 等功能键也可设为全场键
